inlines.v: EVAN'GELIST, noun A writer of the history, or doctrines, precepts, actions, life and death of our blessed Savior, Jesus Christ; as the four evangelists, Matthew, Mark, Luke and John. 1. A preacher or publisher of the gospel of Jesus Christ, licensed to preach, but not having charge of a particular church.
